The Gaussian width term `w(𝒳)` of the action set `𝒳`: the infimum of `gwMat 𝒳 A` over the positive definite design matrices `A` of `𝒳`.

The set of design matrices of `𝒳`: the convex hull of `{x xᵀ : x ∈ 𝒳}`, that is the set of matrices `∑ λ_x x xᵀ` for `λ` a finitely supported probability distribution on `𝒳`.
